'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Cole Lepine DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cole Lepine]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Ontrops'''. Username '''clepine'''. L24 Officer Evax struck → Commander Merrejk. L29 scratch → Ni Chuba Na? (V). L59 Blizzard 4 V circled then marked NOT V. Shield11 Fate Decide marked Not V.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Username:''' clepine
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
